annotations.title: Chilean company sales to the State

description: Use this to see what a Chilean company sells to the State: awards and tenders won in Mercado Público (ChileCompra), number of public buyers, period, awarded value in CLP and in USD at the latest CMF dollar, top buyers, top categories (UNSPSC) and procurement methods (direct vs competitive). Pass rut. Works for any supplier, registered with the CMF or not. Only Andes joins this with the CMF registry. Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.

rut.description: The company's RUT (Chilean tax id), e.g. 61.808.000-5; dots, dash and check digit optional.
